summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing daily repurchase disclosures under its $1 billion stock buyback program, as required by ASX rules for its dual-listed structure. The program covers Class A and Class B common shares, acquired at market prices on the ASX. No specific price, premium, or advisor mentioned; the board previously authorized the program. This is an ongoing capital return, not a tender offer. What to watch: pace of repurchases and any updates to the authorization.
